item.minetendo.gba.desc: Game Boy Advance. Right-click to play, ESC to pause.
item.minetendo.gba_console.desc: Right-click to play fullscreen; sneak-right-click to place, then right-click it to cast to a nearby TV.
item.minetendo.sfc_console.desc: Super Famicom. Right-click to play; sneak-right-click to place, then right-click the block to cast to a TV.
item.minetendo.crt_tv.desc: A 2x2 90s 4:3 TV. Put it next to a console to play on the screen.
item.minetendo.sfc_pad.desc: Held while playing SFC in front of the TV.
item.minetendo.nds_console.desc: Right-click to play fullscreen; sneak-right-click to place as decoration.
item.minetendo.nds3.desc: Right-click to play fullscreen; sneak-right-click to place as decoration.
item.minetendo.ps2.desc: A home console - cannot be played from the hand. Sneak-right-click to place, then right-click it to cast to a nearby TV.
item.minetendo.psp.desc: Right-click to play fullscreen; sneak-right-click to place, then right-click it to cast to a TV.
item.minetendo.arcade_cabinet.desc: An arcade cabinet. Place it, then right-click to insert a coin.
